static_site.deviation_from_the_brief_and_why: The brief says any unknown non-/v1 path returns index.html. Misses under /assets/ and /bundle/ return 404 instead. Those two prefixes are files, not routes: Vite emits content-hashed asset names, so a miss there means the artefact is internally inconsistent, and answering it with index.html hands the browser HTML where it asked for a module - 'Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected token <', which names nothing. Every other unknown path, including '/', deep links and stray links, is index.html with no-cache, as specified.
